introduction.applicationPrefix: This accessibility statement applies to the BMDS application published at
introduction.legalBasis: As a public body within the meaning of Directive (EU) 2016/2102, we endeavour to make our websites and mobile applications accessible in accordance with the provisions of the Federal Disability Equality Act (BGG) and the Accessible Information Technology Ordinance (BITV 2.0), which implements Directive (EU) 2016/2102.

conformance.heading: Compliance Status
conformance.requirements: The accessibility requirements arise from §§ 3 paragraphs 1 to 4 and 4 of BITV 2.0, issued on the basis of § 12d BGG.
conformance.review: Compliance with the requirements was reviewed by ITZBund on the basis of an assessment carried out between June and September 2026 in accordance with the statutory requirements and global standards (EN 301 549, BITV 2.0).
conformance.result: Based on the review, the website is compliant with the aforementioned requirements and therefore conforms to BITV.

feedback.heading: Contact and Feedback Option
feedback.text: Have you noticed deficiencies in the accessibility of content? Or do you have questions about accessibility? Please feel free to contact us:

creation.heading: Creation Date
creation.text: This statement was created on 6 October 2026.

arbitration.heading: Arbitration Procedure
arbitration.text1: If no satisfactory solution is found after your feedback to the contact named above, you can contact the arbitration service under § 16 BGG. The BGG arbitration service supports out-of-court dispute resolution in conflicts concerning accessibility between people with disabilities and federal public bodies. The arbitration procedure is free of charge. Legal counsel is not required.
arbitration.text2Prefix: Further information on the arbitration procedure and application options is available at:
